visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with a high-angle shot of the Taipei 101 skyscraper at night. A series of bright orange and white fireworks are launched horizontally from multiple levels of the building's facade. A bright red illuminated sign with the text 'TAIWAN' is clearly visible on one of the lower sections of the tower. Silhouettes of people are visible at the bottom of the frame, watching the display. (2) The firework patterns shift to green and golden hues, erupting in large, symmetrical fans that extend outward into the dark sky. Billowing clouds of white smoke begin to accumulate around the building's structure. The camera remains mostly static with minor handheld vibrations. (3) A massive cascade of golden sparks pours down from the upper tiers of the building, creating a waterfall-like visual effect. The intensity of the light increases, reflecting off the building's windows. More smoke gathers, partially obscuring the middle section of the tower. (4) The display transitions to a multi-colored sequence featuring pink, blue, and white flares shooting into the air. The camera pans slightly upward to capture the flares rising above the peak of the tower. The 'TAIWAN' sign remains lit throughout the sequence. (5) The building is now heavily shrouded in thick white smoke. Final bursts of blue and gold fireworks are visible through the haze. The camera tilts significantly to the side, creating a Dutch angle perspective as the display reaches its final moments.

visual_human_presence.countingEvidence: Multiple silhouettes of spectators are visible in the foreground at the bottom of the frame.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: The night sky over Taipei, featuring the brightly lit Taipei 101 skyscraper as the central focus.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio opens with a high-energy pop track featuring bright synth keys and a steady electronic drum beat at approximately 128 BPM. A male vocalist begins with melodic vocalizations 'Whoa...' followed by enthusiastic singing. (2) The music enters a chorus section with increased vocal intensity and a driving rhythm. The lyrics discuss 'moments we live for' in an uplifting major key. No audible firework SFX are present, as the music dominates the entire audio track. (3) The vocal line continues with high pitch variability and a clear, professional tone. The instrumental backing maintains a consistent layer of percussion and synthesizers, providing a triumphant atmosphere. (4) The track reaches a peak in volume and energy, mirroring the visual intensification of the fireworks. The male vocal delivery remains projected and powerful, exhibiting high emotional arousal. (5) As the video nears its end, the music continues its high-energy loop. There are no abrupt cuts or fragmented edits in the audio, which sounds like a studio-mastered linear track overlaid on the footage.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Linear: Event progression -> Climax -> Continuous celebration.
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To document and showcase the spectacular 2025 New Year's Eve fireworks display at Taipei 101, using high-energy music to enhance the celebratory and majestic atmosphere of the event.
